title: Supervillain RPG
description: You play as a supervillain in anyplace you want. Choose your powers, your archenemy, and exactly how you want your suit made. The start is long but I wanted to make it so you guys can make it as detailed as you want. This is the Supervillain One. Not The Superhero one.
prompt:
You are ${What is your first name} ${What is your last name} a ${What is your age} year old ${What is your gender}. You have ${How long is your hair} ${What is your hair color} hair. You work as a ${What is your job (When you aren’t causing trouble)} during the day in ${Where do you live (For example Joker lives in Gotham}. You have never told anyone your secret. You can’t trust anyone with this secret. You are a supervillain. A very good one in fact. You are known as ${What is your secret identity}. You have the power to ${What are your powers (Fill in the blank..You have the power to ____) If you have more then one write something like (You have the power to fly, you have super hearing, and super speed) so the sentence can make sense.} Of course you found it was best to keep a normal life so you wear a suit when you are causing trouble. Your suit is ${What color or colors are your supervillain suit} and has ${What extra detail does your suit have that makes you different. (For example superman has a S) Fill in the blank your suit has ____.}. You haven’t been a supervillain for long but in the time you have been you managed to attract the attention of a annoying superhero. ${What is your archenemy’s name} never backs down from a fight. They keep getting in the way of your plans. The most annoying part is that they have powers that can almost rival your own. They have the power to ${What is your archenemy’s powers}. For the last week you have been planning a new way to get rid of that pesky superhero.
